_comment: TDD M4 reverse named-effort slice: unknown caps are neutral, so Responses reasoning.effort passes literally to Chat reasoning_effort. 'minimal' must never be renamed to 'low'. Future-expected (source: protocol.py closed reasoning{effort} + reasoning.py literal preservation + neutral unknown). RED on baseline: current hard refusal 'Responses reasoning requires a same-protocol route' (400 invalid_generation_parameter, zero upstream IO) unlike future exact.
name: m4_reasoning_responses_chat_unknown_neutral_minimal
config:
[server]
auth_mode = "none"
allow_dynamic_routes = false

[retry]
max_attempts = 1

[providers.chatup]
dialect = "openai-chat"
base_url = "{UPSTREAM}"
api_key = "upstream-secret"

[[models]]
name = "bridge-resp"
provider = "chatup"
model = "gpt-4o-mini"
